reason: Cluster 018 moves the six inventory save-format modules to game-application (graph review v3). Three hidden compositions would cross forbidden edges there: InventoryV2StateStore defaulted `cache` to the platform global CacheManager, InventoryItemSnapshotMapper and LegacyItemStateMigration fell back to globalThis.ITEM_PROGRESSION_CONFIG (no globalThis in application), and InventoryV2LegacyMigration read the raw table ITEM_ASSEMBLY_PROFILE_CONFIG (game-config-raw is not an allowed game-application dependency). Framework Q4: remove a default only after proving every production construction passes the dependency; no new validation.
constructionEvidence: grep src utils: `new InventoryV2StateStore` occurs once (InventoryV2CompositionRoot.compose), which always passes the `cache:` key (`cache || (typeof CacheManager ... : null)`), so the removed default never applied; a missing cache still throws the existing TypeError. No check constructs the store directly.

The fallback `typeof ITEM_PROGRESSION_CONFIG !== "undefined" ? ITEM_PROGRESSION_CONFIG : globalThis.ITEM_PROGRESSION_CONFIG` becomes `... : undefined`: when the identifier is not resolvable the global object has no such property either, so both forms yield undefined; the guarded read stays (the mapper/migration targets import ITEM_PROGRESSION_CONFIG from game-config, an allowed dependency). ItemFreshnessStatePolicy defaults stay: allowed application -> domain edge and production (InventoryV2CompositionRoot) does not pass the policy.

`new InventoryV2LegacyMigration` occurs once in production (InventoryV2CompositionRoot.#migrateLegacy); the composition root already reads ITEM_ASSEMBLY_PROFILE_CONFIG for its own AssemblyProfileRegistry and now passes the same table as `assemblyProfileConfig`; the migration builds its registry from the injected table (same object identity). The one direct test construction (inventory-v2-migration-check) passes it explicitly.

The Manifest reclassification platform -> game-application is not part of this preparation: the cluster 036 CacheManager bridge of InventoryV2StateStore (bridge-6f2effa3edcf) retires only when its consumer migrates, and a preparation record has no bridge-retirement field (a new field would be an owner decision), so the reclassified boundary and the bridge retirement land together in the cluster 018 commit; save-round-trip evidence is captured on this commit, before that apply.
